root_cause.text: The ioctl handler in amdgpu_userq_wait_ioctl uses WARN_ON_ONCE for input validation that can be triggered by userspace-provided num_fences being too small, allowing userspace to trivially cause kernel warning backtraces (a denial-of-service vector).
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes WARN_ON_ONCE calls in the guard conditions (e.g., `if (WARN_ON_ONCE(num_fences >= wait_info->num_fences))`) and replaces them with plain `if` statements returning -EINVAL, as described in the commit message: "Userspace can either deliberately pass in the too small num_fences… we do not want to emit the kernel warning backtrace".
